pending_interview.question: A large regional hospital network approaches your team. They want to use AI to automatically generate first-draft clinical documentation — essentially, have an AI listen to a doctor's patient visit and produce a structured note that the doctor then reviews and signs off on. They have a six-month timeline, an internal IT team of twelve engineers, and have already been approached by two vendors with off-the-shelf products. Walk me through how you would scope this engagement, what your first thirty days would look like, and how you would advise them on whether to buy a vendor solution, build in-house, or take a hybrid approach.
